Nick Halloway (bowe@rain.org) wrote:

: It's true.  I saw an article on CNN describing one of Mc Veigh's letters
: as "rambling".  You have to laugh.  Just about anything can be 
: described as "rambling".  TS Eliot's "Wasteland" rambles ...

Exactly. It's the old "freedom fighters vs. Marxist terrorists" story that
the stupid American infomedia perpetuates.

A revolutionary organization, if on the side of the peasants and against
the rich fascists who control the country, is always called "Marxist
Terrorists" (Kabila in Zaire/Congo is an example of a "Marxist 
Terrorist").

A revolutionary organization, if controlled by the Americans and
*supporting* the rich fascists who want to take over a country, is always
called "freedom fighters" (Manuel Noriega is a "freedom fighter").

Of course, now Kabila has turned out to be a nice guy, and Noriega don't
look so hot, so hopefully some very few smart people might start to get a
clue. Chomsky knew this years ago, of course.
